intro.ko: 저녁 7시, 창문이 활짝 열린 부엌. 방금 여기서 무슨 일이 있었을까?
intro.en: 7 p.m., a kitchen with the window thrown wide open. What just happened here?

options.en: A fire, and the fire department came

ask.en: How did it end up burned?

options.en: They forgot about it while watching a movie

ask.en: Why is the smoke alarm's battery out?

options.en: A kid was messing with it
It was blaring, so someone pulled it

ask.en: Why are the window open and the fan on?

label.ko: 가스레인지 위, 바닥이 새까맣게 탄 냄비
label.en: A pot on the stove, scorched black at the bottom

label.ko: 활짝 열린 창문을 향해 돌아가는 선풍기
label.en: A fan blowing toward the wide-open window

label.ko: 조리대 위에 빼 놓은 화재경보기 배터리
label.en: The smoke alarm's battery, pulled out and left on the counter

label.ko: 냄비 주변에 흩어진 새까만 팝콘 알갱이
label.en: Charred popcorn kernels scattered around the pot

label.ko: 옆방 TV에 멈춰 있는 영화 화면
label.en: A movie paused on the TV in the next room

detective.ko: 냄비 바닥이 새까맣게 탔고, 주변엔 까맣게 그을린 팝콘 알갱이가 흩어져 있다. 진짜 불이 났다면 소방관이 다녀간 흔적이 있겠지만, 탄 건 냄비 하나뿐이다. 옆방 TV엔 영화가 일시정지돼 있다. 팝콘을 올려 두고 영화를 보다가 깜빡한 것이다. 화재경보기 배터리는 빠진 채 조리대 위에 놓여 있다 — 요란하게 울려 대니 일단 빼 버렸다. 그리고 활짝 열린 창문을 향해 돌아가는 선풍기. 부엌에 가득 찬 연기를 빼는 중이다.
detective.en: The pot is scorched black at the bottom, and charred popcorn kernels are scattered around it. A real fire would leave signs of firefighters; here, the only casualty is one pot. In the next room, a movie sits paused on the TV: the popcorn went on the stove, the movie went on, and the popcorn was forgotten. The smoke alarm's battery has been yanked out and left on the counter — it was shrieking, so it got silenced. And a fan is blowing toward the wide-open window. Someone is airing out a kitchen full of smoke.
